package position

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdatePositionInput holds update data.
type UpdatePositionInput struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

// UpdatePosition updates a position.
type UpdatePosition struct {
	Positions repository.PositionRepository
}

// Handle updates a position and returns the latest state.
func (uc UpdatePosition) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdatePositionInput) (domain.Position, error) {
	if err := uc.Positions.Update(ctx, domain.Position{ID: in.ID, Name: in.Name}); err != nil {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}
	updated, err := uc.Positions.GetByID(ctx, in.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}
	if updated == nil {
		return domain.Position{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *updated, nil
}
